verdict.rationale: The firm's IP practice page says it covers "unpatented technology" alongside patents, trademarks, copyright and designs. That is the closest first-party reference to trade-secret-type protection, but it never names trade secrets, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. The employment page's "individual employee disputes" is related but is not documented as trade-secret work, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit trade-secret practice description, confidentiality-program advisory work, employee-mobility or non-compete dispute matters, trade-secret litigation examples, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: Patented and unpatented technology, trademarks, copyright and designs
